title: A new empirical equation for the gas/particle partitioning of OPFRs in ambient atmosphere
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,202-210
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00531G, Paper
Man Li, Wenhao Hou, Lina Qiao, Hong Zhang, Mengdan Wang, Yonghui Wen, Zejiang Jia
A new empirical equation for the EQ domain has been developed that increases the percentage of data points falling within the ADR from 23.1% to 75.8%.
